evidence_type.description: Output 'internal_fact' for context info, 'external_source' for EU Taxonomy legislation.

source.description: For internal_fact: 'context_snippet', 'question_text', or 'attachment'. For external_source: The ELI citation (e.g. 'ELI:reg_del/2021/2139/oj').

locator.description: REQUIRED for external_source (Format: 'Annex X | Section Y'). OMIT for internal_fact.

version.description: REQUIRED for external_source (e.g. 'OJ L 442, 09.12.2021'). OMIT for internal_fact.

quote_anchor.description: Verbatim quote. For internal_fact: from context. For external_source: from legislation.

reasoning_logic.description: Forensic explanation of why the evidence leads to the selected option.
